articles.title: Novel ADC Could Expand Treatment Options in Ovarian Cancer
articles.excerpt: (MedPage Today) -- Updated results from the FONTANA trial presented at the annual European Society for Medical Oncology congress showed promising activity with the investigational antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) torvutatug samrotecan (torvu-sam...
articles.summary: MedPage Today 的 ESMO 会议报道介绍 FONTANA 试验更新结果：研究性抗体偶联药物 torvutatug samrotecan（torvu-sam）在卵巢癌中显示初步抗肿瘤活性，可能拓展治疗选择。
